llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a Notifications screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Notifications screen is registered in the stack navigator under the key 'Notifications' with NotificationsScreen component.
evidence: screens: { Home: HomeScreen, Notifications: { screen: NotificationsScreen, ... } }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must model filter as an optional navigation param for the notifications screen.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Route type annotation declares params as optional ({ params?: { filter?: string } }), making filter an optional navigation param.
evidence: useRoute<{ key: string; name: 'Notifications'; params?: { filter?: string } }>()

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must default filter to all when the param is absent.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Nullish coalescing operator defaults filter to 'all' when route.params?.filter is absent.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must render the normalized filter value in the screen UI.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The filter value is rendered in a Text component inside NotificationsScreen.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Navigator is built with createNativeStackNavigator (static API) and wrapped via createStaticNavigation, which is rendered as <Navigation /> in App.
